categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in construction engineering services including residential buildings, commercial office buildings, public facility construction, mechanical and electrical engineering, and turnkey projects. It also engages in investment businesses related to construction and real estate development. The company has expanded into aluminum formwork systems and integrates BIM technology for construction management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced construction technologies such as high-strength reinforced concrete methods (SD550 and SD690), BIM (Building Information Modeling) for design and construction integration, automated construction inspection apps, and aluminum formwork systems to replace traditional wooden templates. It also applies digital tools like point cloud and drone technology for site inspection and 3D modeling, and focuses on low-carbon and energy-efficient building methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies commissioning public housing and infrastructure projects, large private enterprises for commercial and industrial buildings, and real estate developers. The company serves markets in residential, commercial office, industrial plants, and public facilities sectors, targeting both public and private construction projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations are primarily concentrated in Taiwan, especially in the northern and southern regions. It undertakes projects across major cities including Taipei, New Taipei, Taichung, and Kaohsiung, with no significant international construction operations reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the construction supply chain, focusing on construction project execution, turnkey contracting, and integrated mechanical and electrical engineering services. It relies on upstream suppliers for raw materials like steel, cement, and aluminum, which are often imported.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing differentiated construction technologies such as patented high-strength concrete methods and aluminum formwork, enhancing BIM and digital construction management systems, and promoting green and low-carbon building practices. The company invests in R&D to automate construction processes, improve quality and safety, and integrate sustainability and ESG principles into operations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through project-based construction contracts including general contracting, turnkey projects, and mechanical and electrical engineering services. The company also derives income from investments and licensing of patented construction technologies. Revenue is recognized upon project completion stages and service delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with numerous domestic construction firms in Taiwan, many of which are small to medium-sized enterprises. It positions itself as a leading integrated construction service provider with strong technical capabilities, patented technologies, and a focus on quality and sustainability, differentiating itself from competitors through innovation and comprehensive service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$6.12 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 46% growth over the prior year, with net profit doubling to NT$681.7 million. It has a stable financial structure with total assets exceeding NT$9 billion and equity around NT$4.9 billion. The company shows a positive growth trajectory supported by large-scale public and private projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, technologically advanced, and sustainable construction solutions. Its unique value lies in patented low-carbon construction methods, integration of BIM and digital tools for project management, and comprehensive turnkey services that reduce construction time and costs. Commitment to ESG and safety standards further differentiates it in the market.
